name: Scheme for Facilitating Start-Ups Intellectual Property Protection (SIPP)
summary: Reimburses the statutory and facilitator fees for DPIIT-recognised startups filing patents, trademarks and designs, using government-empanelled facilitators.
administering_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
implementing_agency: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
benefit_description: Central Government bears the entire facilitator fee for any number of patents, trademarks or designs filed; startup only pays the statutory fee. Domestic patent filing/prosecution costs reimbursed up to Rs. 2 lakh per patent awarded; foreign patents up to Rs. 10 lakh.

criteria.description: Applicant must be a startup recognised by DPIIT under the notification GSR 127(E) dated 19.2.2019, as amended from time to time.
criteria.source_quote: Any startup recognised in terms of the notification GSR 127(E) published in the Gazette of India dated 19.2.2019, as may be amended from time to time.

criteria.description: The Certificate of Recognition given by DPIIT can be verified from the Startup India web portal before facilitator assistance is confirmed.
criteria.source_quote: The Certificate of Recognition given by DPIIT may be verified from the Startup India web portal http://www.startupindia.gov.in.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the Startup India portal; recognition certificate is issued after review.
Engage a facilitator from the panel published by the Office of the CGPDTM.
Pay the statutory fee for the IP filing; the facilitator fee itself is reimbursed by government.

windows.notes: Rolling scheme, extended in three-year cycles since its initial pilot phase (in force to 31-3-2020, then extended).

benefits.description: Reimbursement of facilitator fees for patent, trademark and design filings; capped reimbursement of statutory patent costs.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Facilitator files reimbursement claim online after completing the filing on the startup's behalf.
benefits.source_quote: the Central Government shall bear the entire fees of the facilitators for any number of patents, trademarks or designs that a recognised startup may file, and the Startups shall bear the cost of only the statutory fees payable to facilitator as per the notification.
